SELECT 
  sale_date,
  SUM(net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE channel_code = 'WB'
  AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'
GROUP BY sale_date
ORDER BY sale_date

SELECT 
  MIN(sale_date) AS min_date,
  MAX(sale_date) AS max_date
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE channel_code = 'WB'

SELECT 
  sale_date,
  SUM(net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE channel_code = 'WB'
  AND sale_date >= DATE '2025-10-15'
GROUP BY sale_date
ORDER BY sale_date DESC
LIMIT 20
